entries.value: Each holy man or woman is the autonomous leader of their own branch, with however many followers they can gather
Multiple bishops or high priests, friendly or otherwise, with subordinate clergy each obedient to their own superior
A single archbishop, abbot, or high priest with a layer of senior clergy beneath them
Individual congregations or grove-circles are independent, with their clergy subject to the consensus will of their people
Powerful lay believers fund temples or monasteries subject to their family's control
No official clergy; some believers take up special roles but are not qualitatively different from others
The church is entirely part of the secular structure of the land; its clergy are officials appointed by the lord
Roll twice; the faith has different structures in different places
